construction: Manually specified numeric inputs and complete output words serialized little-endian. Only byte/word/chain consistency was checked by stdlib; no HIA/Rust oracle/VM/native call or cost evaluator ran. MAX numeric boundaries do not allocate strings or execute callbacks.
coverage_limits: Raw ABI cases cannot prove real audio callback order, Vec/String ownership or exact truncate_text contents. The original Rust/public oracle and Root-owned paired tests remain required.
Arbitrary well-shaped forged numeric histories cannot be authenticated by this ABI. Rejection covers the declared numeric/phase/canonical bounds.
No performance, interruption atomicity, fuel or cross-platform qualification.
